question: What is the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘fluctuate’?
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word** 'fluctuate' **means to vary or change irregularly.
 
• Its antonym **should convey the idea of remaining constant or steady.**
 
• Among the given options**, 'Stabilise' **is the **most appropriate antonym as it means to make or become stable or steady.**
 
• The other options do not accurately convey the opposite meaning of** 'fluctuate'.**

Hence, the **antonym** of** 'fluctuate' is 'stabilise.'**
